cli_contract.official_cli_state: NOT INVOCABLE on this host: no ~/.local/bin/obsidian shim, no /usr/local/bin/obsidian, no obsidian-cli binary (pacman -Ql obsidian ships only the GUI launcher + asars); socket $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/.obsidian-cli.sock is transient (present only while the desktop app runs — spawned by sibling seats' probes, absent between runs)
cli_contract.no_hash_command: the 1.14.4 bundle (obsidian-1.14.4.asar) registers no hash/digest CLI command: `vault` handler supports only info: name|path|files|folders|size; grep -c 'vault:hash' -> 0. Full handler inventory (registerHandler + registerCliHandler): bases, bookmark(s), command(s), create, daily, deadends, delete, diff, file(s), folder(s), help, history, hotkey(s), links, move, open, orphans, outline, plugin(s), prepend, properties, random, read, recents, reload, rename, restart, search, snippets, sync, tabs, tag(s), task(s), templates, theme(s), unique, unresolved, vault, vaults, version, web, wordcount, workspace(s), workspaces
cli_contract.third_party: obsidian-cli-inspector v1.0.3 is a third-party read-only index (its 'Hash' field is size:mtime, not a content digest — reproduced by S42/S35) and notesmd-cli v0.3.7 implements list-vaults only; neither is a sha256 oracle
cli_contract.consequence: sha256sum under the vault path is the only vault-side oracle available; any `--cli` path must be advisory and must degrade to the fallback. impl-20's cli call target `vault:hash` is hypothetical (interface the real CLI does not implement); harmless today (unavailable/timeout -> fallback decides) but must not be recorded as a live CLI capability
